The '''kalidor''' was an avian predator from [[Davnar II/Legends|Davnar II]]. Some people considered it the most perfect flying creature of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] created the [[Kalidor Crescent/Legends|''Kalidor Crescent'']] as an award to pilots for outstanding flying skills and bravery.
